manifest.description: Recognizes music on live audio sources such as a turntable. Known tracks are recognized locally from fingerprints it learns; unknown tracks are identified by sending a short sample to AudD (a paid service with a free trial; API token required). A known track without a stored length is sent to AudD once, to learn it.
manifest.name: Audio Recognizer: AudD + Local Fingerprints

manifest.description: Plays the history of your Home Assistant as generative soundscapes: every area is an artist, every day an album, and each album holds one slowly evolving piece in five styles (Ambient, Berlin School, Lo-fi, Ritual, Cinematic Glitch). The pieces are made by generative systems that your house steers with texture, density, brightness and space, never note by note. It only reads from Home Assistant and synthesises the audio while it plays, from CC0 samples that ship with it. Covers are drawn locally from the day. When the rooms you show change, it asks Music Assistant to re-sync its own items.
manifest.name: Entropy FM
